reviews.text: Excellent facilities with a responsible, competent and humane team.
Friendliness and professionalism are the dominant characteristics of their service.
Medical quality. Fast diagnosis. I highly recommend it.

Quick to provide initial emergency care. They have excellent infrastructure and equipment to quickly diagnose and stabilize the patient (pet). Care and attention for the pet. I highlight the service and professionalism of Dr. Inês Tavares and Dr. Sara Coelho, and the friendliness and attentiveness of all the professionals, from reception onwards.
Super helpful and honest! I highly recommend them.
Thank you for your 5-star review! ☺️ We're happy to know you're satisfied with our service!
Excellent service. Very professional and efficient veterinarians. I take my 5 cats there and they have always been very well treated.

My cat had swelling and irritation in his third eyelid. After several treatments, there were no results, so we decided to take him to the cat hospital. They told us that the cat would have to have surgery and that he risked losing his eye. My cat came home after the eye removal and complained a lot about his mouth, especially when we gave him medication. We didn't understand why, since he had surgery on his eye and not his mouth, so we contacted the veterinarian, who told us that a tooth had been removed (something that had not been mentioned to us at any time). As you know, it's not easy to give medication to cats, so for two days we were "sticking our fingers" in the cat's mouth, when he had just had a tooth and an eye removed – imagine the pain! The cavity where the tooth was removed ended up developing an infection. We took him to the hospital two more times, and there was no recovery, where everything was always charged to us, spending a total of between €400-€500. Unfortunately, it never recovered, and ended up developing pus, which began to ooze from my cat's nose and eye socket. Although the eye biopsy reported that it had soft tissue cancer (low survival rate), I didn't want to see my cat go through so much suffering, and I ended up losing him within 3 weeks.

We waited an hour for the vet and left without being seen.
No sufficient explanation was given for the delay.
They could have called to reschedule or at least let us know, but nothing happened; my cat simply waited an hour in the carrier.

An unfortunate visit.
